points.description: Tool point: the origin of gripper_frame_link in the SO-101 URDF (so101_new_calib.urdf), fixed to the gripper 98 mm along the wrist_roll axis from that joint's frame origin (and 8 mm off the axis), toward the jaw tips.
Elbow joint centre: the origin of the elbow_flex joint frame in the SO-101 URDF (link lower_arm_link), on the elbow_flex axis at the end of the upper arm.
Wrist joint centre: the origin of the wrist_flex joint frame in the SO-101 URDF (link wrist_link), on the wrist_flex axis at the end of the forearm.

notes: Converted from an ev03-harness arm envelope. As in the harness, keep_in bounds the tool point only, link_keep_in bounds the link points (elbow, wrist), and every keep_out applies to every point. The harness applied max_joint_speed_dps to the five arm joints, not the gripper. The stop and heartbeat blocks were supplied at conversion; the harness format declares neither. Illustrative SO-101 tabletop envelope. Base frame: x forward, y left, z up, origin at the base on the table. Metres. Replace with your own measured layout before a hardware run. keep_out_0: e.g. a camera mount or fixture on the table. link_keep_in: Box for the elbow and wrist joint centres (kinematics.LINK_JOINTS): the work cell, 3 cm above the table so the servo bodies stay clear of it. The keep-outs apply to them too. The stop and heartbeat values are illustrative placeholders, not measured: EV-02 (stop time and distance) has not been run on this arm.
